meta.note: P0 candidates are the must-do-before-module items. Total cost must NOT balloon into multi-week engineering. Cap at 15.

p0_candidates.title: Semantic Data Type & Precision Convention (BASE-001)
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: All money/qty/price fields need this. Wrong precision → financial audit failure. Wrong rounding → 0.01 lost per sum.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Every SalesOrder/PurchaseOrder/Inventory table would need precision annotation. If we set defaults wrong in POC-003, we change every column. Tax calculations (1.13 multiplications) need scale >= 4 for HALF_EVEN safety.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 1-2 days: write semantic-data-type.json (already done in MDM-000D R1); add C# attribute library; 1 day: migrate POC-003 fields to use attribute; 0.5 day: unit tests

p0_candidates.title: Numbering Convention (BASE-002)
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: DocumentNumber is identity of business documents. Wrong scope (system vs tenant) = production data corruption. Wrong UNIQUE constraint = race condition.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Every Doc table (SO/PO/GR/GI/MO/QC) needs NumberSequence + UNIQUE constraint. POC-003 has IBusinessNumberGenerator but no UNIQUE constraint. Migrations need re-run.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: NumberSequence entity + DB UNIQUE constraint; 0.5 day: ResetPolicy enum + manual number support; 0.5 day: tenant scope; 1 day: integration test
deliverables: UNIQUE (TenantId, DocType, Year, Serial) DB constraint

p0_candidates.title: Parameter Scope Convention (BASE-003)
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: Settings need to be scoped. System/Tenant/Company/Plant. Wrong scope = wrong data leaks between tenants/plants.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Each module needs TenantSetting/CompanySetting/PlantSetting. If we hardcode as column, refactor every read site.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: ISystemSetting abstraction; 0.5 day: TenantSetting/CompanySetting/PlantSetting tables; 0.5 day: G2-002 config validation extension; 0.5 day: tests
evidence_files: G2-003 migration: gulierp_company has DefaultCurrency + Timezone already; gulierp_plant has Timezone + CountryCode + CalendarCode

p0_candidates.title: Foundation Cross-Cutting Convention (BASE-004)
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: Single source of truth for: SnowflakeId, ConcurrencyVersion, AuditLog, DesignLog, SoftDelete, StatusStateMachine, CommentObligation. Each is a small rule, but the SUM is huge if done per-module.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Each module would invent its own: id generation, version field, soft delete mechanism, status field. POC-003 already uses some, but not consistently enforced.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 1 day: SnowflakeId (already in G2-001) + ConcurrencyVersion (already pattern); 1 day: AuditLog + DesignLog split; 1 day: SoftDelete entity; 0.5 day: status state machine library; 0.5 day: pg_description migration; 0.5 day: test + doc

p0_candidates.title: UOM Convention with Dimension + Conversion
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: UOM is cross-module (Sales/PO/Inventory/Production). Wrong dimension metadata = kg vs m cross-dimension bugs. Conversion not modeled = WMS inefficiency.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: SalesOrderLine.UomId, PurchaseOrderLine.UomId, Item.BaseUomId all FK to Uom. If dimension not enforced, each module invents its own guard.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: UomDimension enum (8 dimensions); 0.5 day: UomConversion table (from_code+to_code+ratio+validity); 0.5 day: Item.BaseUomId; 0.5 day: tests

p0_candidates.title: Currency + ExchangeRate Convention
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: Money without currency = nonsense. Cross-currency transactions need ExchangeRate with valid date.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Each module that has money needs CurrencyCode + ExchangeRateId. If not done early, backfill is painful.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: Currency entity (ISO 4217 subset); 0.5 day: ExchangeRate entity; 0.5 day: ExchangeRateProvider interface; 0.5 day: tests
evidence_files: DEV has no currency table; MDM-000D R1 prepared seed

p0_candidates.title: Tax Code + Inclusive/Exclusive Convention
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: Tax is on every SalesOrderLine and PurchaseOrderLine. Inclusive/Exclusive flag changes amount meaning.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: SO/PO/GR/GI all need TaxCodeId + TaxInclusive flag. Add later = migrate every line.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: TaxCode entity; 0.5 day: SalesOrderLine/POLine/GRLine fields; 1 day: tax calculation service with inclusive/exclusive; 0.5 day: tests
evidence_files: DEV 收支科目 dictionary (7 items, 5 types)  --  too coarse for tax

p0_candidates.title: InventoryStatus Convention
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: Available vs Reserved vs Blocked is core. Wrong = oversold or understocked.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: InventoryBalance needs 5 separate decimal fields. POC-002 design already exists; this is to enforce + tests.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: InventoryStatus enum; 0.5 day: InventoryBalance schema with 5 fields; 0.5 day: IInventoryService.PostAsync; 0.5 day: tests

p0_candidates.title: BP Code Format + Address/Contact Convention
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: BP is shared across Sales/Purchase/Inventory. Code format is hard to backfill.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Customer / Supplier / Subcontractor / Logistics all share BP table. Wrong code format = rename campaign later.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: BP.Code prefix (CUST-/SUPP-/SUB-/LOG-); 0.5 day: BPAddress entity (type=BILLING/SHIPPING/REGISTERED); 0.5 day: BPContact (type=PHONE/EMAIL/FAX); 0.5 day: tests
evidence_files: DEV 往来表 sample: 往来号=20001 (no prefix)

p0_candidates.title: Item Master Convention (Type/Category/BaseUom)
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: Item is shared. Type/Category/BaseUom are FK fields, not strings. Wrong = each module re-derives.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Item is in Inventory/Sales/Production/QC. If type is string, each module re-validates. Promote to enum + FK.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: ItemType enum (5 types incl. Phantom); 0.5 day: ItemCategory tree entity; 0.5 day: Item.BaseUomId; 0.5 day: tests
evidence_files: DEV 商品属性 dictionary (4 items: 自制/外购/委外加工/客供); 商品分类 (5 items sample)

p0_candidates.title: Document Status State Machine Library
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: SO has Draft/Confirmed/Shipped/Closed. PO has Draft/Confirmed/Received/Closed. Without library, each entity rolls own state machine  --  bugs.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: POC-003 already has SalesOrder state machine. Without library, future modules will copy-paste.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: IAggregateStateMachine<T> abstraction; 0.5 day: state machine library (use Stateless or hand-rolled); 0.5 day: per-entity state config; 0.5 day: tests

p0_candidates.title: Field-Level Comment Obligation
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: pg_description on every column. Cheap to do, hard to retrofit.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Future dev onboard slower. Schema documentation rots.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.25 day: EF Core convention for pg_description; 0.25 day: architecture test (ArchUnit) for column comments; 0.25 day: doc
evidence_files: DEV 0/151 JU_ tables have ms_description  --  anti-pattern

p0_candidates.title: Concurrency Version Pattern Enforcement
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: ConcurrencyVersion int already in G2-003 tables. Without enforcement, new tables may forget.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: Each module may invent its own row version. POC-003 has it; future modules must follow.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.25 day: IVersioned interface; 0.25 day: EF Core convention; 0.25 day: architecture test
p0_candidates.dependency: G2-003 Identity already has ConcurrencyVersion in every table
evidence_files: Identity migration v1  --  every table has ConcurrencyVersion int

p0_candidates.title: AggregateState Status (Replace 3-field status anti-pattern)
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: DEV anti-pattern: ReportStatus + LockStatus + WorkflowStatus on same entity. Untestable combinations.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: POC-003 already uses 3D model (DocumentStatus/ApprovalStatus/ExecutionStatus). Make this a Foundation contract.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: DocumentStatus/ApprovalStatus/ExecutionStatus enums; 0.5 day: IDocumentState<T> contract; 0.5 day: tests

p0_candidates.title: IDiscoverableAndTruncatable Configuration (Preflight)
p0_candidates.why_must_come_first: G2-004R1 had PowerShell $PID collision bug. Code generator pitfalls. Need a process to discover pitfalls before they bite.
p0_candidates.rework_if_deferred: P0-05..P0-14 each could be caught at discovery time instead of after implementation.
p0_candidates.effort_breakdown: 0.5 day: pattern catalog of common ERP gotchas (DEV-derived); 0.5 day: preflight checklist template
deliverables: Each future goal reviews against it before kickoff
evidence_files: G2-004R1 PID bug, G2-003V2 RI report
